I was making breakfast for my family recently on a Sunday, I was being the awesome dad. I had a pound of bacon and a pound of sausage frying while I was cooking chocolate-chip waffles. My wife asked me why I was making so much food, that we really didn't need that much and we'd end up just having to put a bunch of it in the fridge as leftovers. I replied that I always make extra waffles and the kids eat them like toast on other mornings. She said, "No, the bacon and sausage."

I stared blankly at her, "You...you can refrigerate cooked bacon?". It had never occurred to me that bacon or sausage could be leftovers. Growing up as the youngest of five kids, that sort of thing never happened. I was cooking a lot because, as the youngest of five, I barely got the amount I wanted growing up and now I had the power to change it.
